about_the_game:
You awake in a mysterious facility and quickly realize something is wrong- you are not alone and everything is trying to kill you. 

  • Fight your way through this dark and mysterious facility. With dynamic level generation, no run will be the same. 

  • No Time For Pants permadeath system keeps you on your toes.  You may lose what you have with you, but your next clone will build off your success.

  • Unlock weapons, gear, attachments and experimental technology that will keep you alive and make you deadlier than ever.

  • Your gear and tactics matter- you will need lights to see, but what will you draw out of the darkness? Suppressors will attract less attention, first aid kits will help you heal faster and much, much more.

  • Interactive drag and drop inventory management for modifying loadout and weapons on the run.

  • Modify and enhance your loadout to survive longer and explore deeper into the darkness with every attempt to escape.

  • Gunplay that will make you feel like a bad ass, even if you are in your underpants.

    Thank you for supporting No Time For Pants with your interest in the demo,  there is so much more planned for the full release!

content_descriptors.notes: While the graphics of No Time For Pants are stylized and pixelated, the violence can depict heads exploding, lots of blood and dead bodies.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel 2.77GHz Quad-core
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card with 4GB of RAM minimum, OpenGL 2.1 and GLSL `.1 support
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: FMOD compatible sound card

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Compact, tactical, rogue-lite, 2d action with pixelized graphics and a dark, gritty tone.  Gather all the resources you can and customize your loadout- you must evolve with every death to fight through the horrors that await you. This is No Time For Pants!
